Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][/b][/center][center][b][size=6][color=#ffff00]🌊Immersive Weather Overhaul🐸
[/color][/size][/b][/center][center][b]﻿
[/b][/center][center][i]A balanced, immersive weather-based skill buff & debuff system for Stardew Valley

[size=4][color=#00ff00]Support  [/color][color=#f6b26b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868?tab=description]Weather Wonders - Stable[/url]  [/color]  &   [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39843?tab=description][size=4]WEATHER ALERT[/size][/url]

[size=5]Featured on [url=https://www.gamingbible.com/news/stardew-valley-dynamic-weather-mod-696738-20251202]https://www.gamingbible.com/news/stardew-valley-dynamic-weather-mod-696738-20251202[/url]﻿
[/size]
Support 13 languages

Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][size=3]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/size][/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][/url]
[/i][/center][line][b][color=#ffff00]Weather is no longer cosmetic — it's gameplay.
[/color]
[/b]Dynamic Weather Mastery transforms Stardew Valley's weather into a meaningful part of daily decision-making.
Each weather type grants unique buffs and debuffs that encourage planning, vary your routines, and make Pelican Town feel more alive.
Every day becomes unique.
Every forecast becomes strategic.
Every choice becomes meaningful.

[line][b][color=#ffff00]Key Features
[/color]
[/b][list]
[*][b]Balanced Skill System[/b] — Each weather type provides buffs and debuffs, with buffs always totaling around [b]+1 more[/b] or equal for fair progression.
[*][b]Dynamic Daily Gameplay[/b] — Your ideal activities shift organically with the forecast.
[*][b]Lore-Friendly Design[/b] — Effects match the mood and theme of each weather type.
[*][b]Lightweight & SMAPI-Only[/b] 
[*][b]Multilingual Support[/b] — 13 languages
[*][b]No Cheat Effects[/b] — Pure skill adjustments only; no stamina, movement, or world edits.
[/list][line][b][color=#ffff00]🌦️ Weather Buff Summary[/color][color=#ffff00]🌧️  REDESIGNED
[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff7700]4.0 update: All +2/+1 Fishing weather days now include a small fish-quality bonus for better catches
[/color][/b]
[color=#00ff00][size=3][b]Base Game Weather

[/list][b]Debuffs:[/b]
[list]

[*][b]Secondary:[/b] [i]None (overall positive weather)[/i]
[/list][line][b]⛈️ Storm — “High Risk, High Reward”[/b][b]A day for adventurers, not farmers.[/b]

[*][b]Secondary:[/b] Luck –1 – chaotic and unpredictable conditions
[/list][line][b]☀️ Sunny Summer (Hot) — “Brutal, Bright, Fast-Growing”[/b][b]Ripens crops quickly, punishes anyone working outdoors too long.[/b]

[list]

[*][b]Secondary:[/b] [i]None (heat handled by other weathers)[/i]

[b]Buffs:[/b]

[/list][b]Debuffs:[/b]

[/list][line][color=#00ff00][size=3]🌨️ [/size][/color][b][color=#00ff00][size=3]Weather Wonders — Special Weathers
[/size][/color]
[/b][b]🌨️ Blizzard — “Extreme Cold, Extreme Focus”[/b][b]Brutal outdoors; safer underground.[/b]

[/list][b]Debuffs:[/b]

[list]

[/list][b]Debuffs:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Main:[/b] Farming –1 – slightly reduced sunlight
[/list]
[line]
[b][color=#ffff00][list]
[/list]Why This System Is Balanced
[/color]
[/b][list]
[*]Buff totals always equal or exceed debuffs by exactly [b]1 point[/b].
[*]Never overpowered — guides play rather than dictating it.
[*]Works smoothly with long-term saves and challenge runs.
[*]No exploits, no stat inflation, and no unintended side effects.
[/list]
[line][b][color=#ffff00]Installation
[/color]
[/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b]

[*]Download this mod

[*]Extract it into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder

[*]Launch the game

[/list][line][b][color=#ffff00]Compatibility
[/color]
[b]   * Since it's only affecting base game skill level, it will be compatible with any mod.[/b]
[list]
[*]No dependent besides SMAPI
[*]should be compatible with most mods, but if there is any conflict let me know
[*]✔ Safe for existing saves
[*]✖ Does not modify world assets or visuals
[/list]
